blueprint.product_name: Inglês para o Gás e a Mineração: Kit Turno 15
blueprint.tagline: O inglês do terreno, do CV e da entrevista, no seu telemóvel, em 15 minutos por dia.
blueprint.one_line_pitch: Um kit prático para o telemóvel, para moçambicanos que querem trabalhar na cadeia de fornecimento do gás e da mineração. Aprende o inglês de segurança (HSE), de terreno e de rádio, prepara o CV e a carta de apresentação em inglês com modelos prontos a adaptar, treina a entrevista e aprende a reconhecer vagas falsas. Tudo num plano de 30 dias que gasta poucos dados. Prepara, mas não garante emprego e não tem ligação a nenhuma empresa ou projecto.
why_it_can_win: The timing is real. Mozambique LNG restarted construction in January 2026 with over 4,000 workers mobilised and up to 7,000 Mozambicans expected at peak. Rovuma LNG expects an investment decision around the end of 2026, and the 2026 Local Content Law makes the use of national companies and workers mandatory in oil and gas. Many Mozambicans are looking for a way into this sector, and English is a visible barrier because these projects work in both English and Portuguese.

The niche is specific and less crowded than 'make money online'. It answers a concrete job-seeking need (workplace English, CV, interview) instead of vague income promises, so it can stand out on EscalePay without hype. Mining (Tete, Moma), Pande/Temane gas, logistics and general workplace English widen the audience beyond LNG.

Anti-scam positioning builds trust. Job seekers are targeted by fake offers that ask for fees. A product that openly teaches people to spot those scams is the opposite of a scam, and the free 'Checklist Anti-Burla' spreads easily on WhatsApp.

The price is far below the alternatives. British Council Maputo charges about 28,875 MT per term and Green Pole USD 60-120/month (about 3,840-7,680 MT). At 697 MT (about USD 11) the kit costs less than one week of the cheaper course. It does not replace a full course, but it focuses on the exact workplace and job-search content these buyers need.

It is built for phones and low data. The files are downloaded once (target: under 15 MB for the core kit; measure the real size before stating it on the page), and daily practice is a text, one image and one short voice note in WhatsApp. That fits a market of about 7.12 million internet users who mostly use phones and pay with M-Pesa or e-Mola.

The creator can deliver it alone. Claude drafts the content, the creator checks every line and adds their own voice and English, and the upsell is a CV service delivered with Claude. No budget, team or studio is needed.

Affiliates have a natural home. Admins of job-vacancy Facebook pages and WhatsApp groups already have the exact audience and need honest products to recommend. A 40% commission gives them a reason to promote it.

Order value can grow beyond the 697 MT entry price through the order bump (Áudios de Pronúncia Turno 15, 147 MT), the upsell (Revisão Pessoal: CV + Carta em Inglês, 1,497 MT) and the downsell (Revisão Rápida do CV, 597 MT). Example only, not a forecast: if 25% of buyers take the bump and 5% the upsell, the average order is about 697 + 37 + 75 = 809 MT before fees.

If EscalePay shows a best-seller or trending list (not verified), sales volume and active affiliates are the levers most likely to matter. Being the honest, specific product in a market full of hype is the best long-term bet for that position, but the position itself can never be promised.
honest_risks: Nobody can guarantee a 'top 1 trending' position on EscalePay. It has not been verified whether EscalePay has a public ranking or how it works. Treat 'top seller' as a goal, never a promise, and never write 'nº 1', 'mais vendido' or 'trending' on your pages unless the platform publicly shows it at that moment.
You have no audience yet. The first 14 days may bring only a handful of sales. Results depend on publishing content every day and recruiting affiliates.
Many target buyers are unemployed and have little money to spare. Price sensitivity is high, so expect more people asking for 'free' than buying.

Expectations may be too high. Thirty days of 15 minutes builds basic workplace English, not fluency. Buyers who expect fluency or a job may ask for refunds under the 7-day policy. Say clearly what the product does and does not do.

People may mistake it for a recruitment agency. Some will think buying gives access to jobs, and that is both a reputation and a legal risk. Disclaimers must appear on the page, the checkout description, the PDF and the WhatsApp group rules.

Demand depends on project news. Security incidents in Cabo Delgado or delays (for example to the Rovuma LNG decision) can cool interest. Mining (Tete, Moma), Pande/Temane gas, logistics and general workplace English give you broader angles to fall back on.

EscalePay is a young platform, and some features are company claims or unverified (same-day payout, 1-click upsell, members area, the exact fee of 10% vs 8% + USD 0.50). Run a test purchase, withdraw after every sale and keep your own buyer list.

KYC approval may take days. Start it on Day 1. If it is not approved by Day 7, do not improvise payments to your personal M-Pesa number (that looks exactly like the scams you warn against). Keep building your audience and the /anti-burla contact list until the account is active.
WhatsApp groups can get reported or banned, and members' phone numbers are visible to each other. Use a WhatsApp Community with an admin-only announcements group, and tell members upfront.
Running cohorts is real, ongoing work. With cohorts on the 1st and 15th, two 30-day groups overlap. If that is too much, start with one cohort per month and say so honestly on the page.

Errors carry real weight. Safety vocabulary must be accurate, so you must check every HSE term against reputable public sources, and the product must never present itself as safety training or certification.

Free content competes with you. YouTube and free apps teach English. Your edge is that the content is specific to the sector and to Mozambique, plus the CV, interview and anti-scam parts and the guided 30-day group.

Seven days is tight for one person. The plan works only with simple design. If something is not ready, remove it from the offer (for example, switch off the order bump until the audios are recorded) instead of selling it unfinished.

avatar.who: Mozambican men and women aged 18-40 who have finished 12ª classe or have technical training (técnico básico/médio, INEFP or similar courses). They are, or want to be, construction workers, drivers, warehouse and logistics staff, catering and camp staff, security guards, HSE assistants, electricians, mechanics, welders, scaffolders or admin staff in the gas (LNG) and mining supply chain. They live in Cabo Delgado (Pemba and surrounding areas), Nampula, Tete, Inhambane, Zambézia, Maputo and Matola. Their English level is between zero and basic.
avatar.situation: They have practical skills or a technical qualification, but their CV is only in Portuguese and they freeze when a supervisor, recruiter or form uses English. They follow job-vacancy pages on Facebook and WhatsApp every day and use mobile data sparingly, often on low-memory Android phones. They pay with M-Pesa or e-Mola, rarely have a bank card, and cannot afford a 28,875 MT language course or fixed class times.
pains: 'Conheço o trabalho, mas quando o chefe fala inglês fico calado e com medo de errar.'
They do not understand English safety briefings (toolbox talks), signs and forms, and feel at risk and excluded.
Their CV is only in Portuguese or is a badly translated template, so they do not know how to describe 12ª classe, técnico médio or a driving licence in English.
They fear interviews in English and have never practised one out loud.
They have lost money, or know someone who did, to fake job offers asking for 'taxa de inscrição', 'farda' or 'processamento'.
English courses are expensive, far away, at fixed times and use a lot of data.
They feel that 'o emprego vai para os de fora' because of the language barrier.
desires: To understand and respond to basic workplace instructions and safety words with confidence.
To have a clean English CV and cover letter ready to send the moment a real vacancy opens.
To answer 'Tell me about yourself' and common interview questions without freezing.
To protect their money and documents from fake job offers.
To learn on the phone, in short sessions, without spending much data.
To feel prepared and competitive under the new local-content opportunities.

'Já fui burlado antes, porque confiar?' Answer: You pay on EscalePay's checkout with M-Pesa/e-Mola, never to a personal number, you get access right after payment, and you have a 7-day refund guarantee. We never ask for money for vacancies.
'O meu inglês é zero.' Answer: The kit starts from zero, with approximate pronunciation written for Portuguese speakers.
'Não tenho dados nem tempo.' Answer: Download once, then 15 minutes per day. Daily group practice is a short text, a small image and a voice note.
'Não tenho computador.' Answer: Everything works on the phone. The CV templates open in Google Docs or Word on the phone.

'Há coisas grátis no YouTube.' Answer: Yes, but scattered and not for our sector. Here you get the vocabulary, the CV, the interview and the anti-scam guide in one 30-day plan, with a group to practise speaking.

'Como recebo o produto?' Answer: Access comes right after payment, in the members area or by link (confirm the real method in your test purchase), and the WhatsApp group link is inside the access area.
'É afiliado à TotalEnergies/Exxon?' Answer: No. It is an independent product with no ties to any company, project or government entity.

blueprint.promise: Em 30 dias, com cerca de 15 minutos por dia no telemóvel, aprende o inglês essencial de segurança (HSE), de terreno, de rádio e de formulários, prepara o seu CV e a sua carta de apresentação em inglês com modelos prontos a adaptar, treina as respostas às perguntas mais comuns de entrevista e aprende a reconhecer vagas falsas que pedem dinheiro. É preparação real, que depende da sua prática diária, e sem promessas de emprego.
blueprint.mechanism_explained: Turno 15 is a daily 15-minute 'shift' of practice, designed for a phone and very little data. Every day has three 5-minute blocks: (1) RECONHECER: read one daily vocabulary card (5-8 workplace words or phrases) with the meaning and an approximate pronunciation written for Portuguese speakers (e.g. 'hazard' = 'RÉ-zârd'). (2) REPETIR: say each word and the example sentence out loud 3 times, copying the creator's daily voice note in the group (or the order-bump audios, for buyers who added them). (3) RESPONDER: complete a short real-world challenge, such as a voice note answering a supervisor-style question, one line of an incident report or one interview answer, and post it in the WhatsApp practice group. Each week follows a real workplace theme so learning builds on itself: Week 1 Safety/HSE; Week 2 site instructions, numbers and radio; Week 3 forms, emails, CV and cover letter; Week 4 the interview; Days 29-30 review and a final mock interview. Why it works: (a) it covers situations workers actually meet (toolbox talks, permit to work, radio checks, induction forms, interviews), not generic English; (b) learners speak out loud every day, which builds confidence faster than reading; (c) small daily wins and a visible checklist help people finish; (d) it is light on data: the files are downloaded once (target under 15 MB for the core kit) and the daily group content is text, one image and one voice note (target under 1 MB a day). Group set-up: one WhatsApp Community per cohort, with an admin-only announcements group (the daily challenge) and a practice group where members post their voice notes. The creator moderates each cohort for 30 days and gives group feedback several times a week. Cohorts start on fixed dates (for example the 1st and 15th of each month, or once a month if you have less time), which also gives an honest, real deadline for sign-ups.

modules.title: Módulo 1: Inglês de Segurança (HSE)
modules.goal: Recognise and say the core international HSE vocabulary used on sites, in inductions and on signs.
lessons: EPI em inglês (PPE): hard hat, safety boots, gloves, hi-vis vest, safety glasses, ear protection, harness
Perigos e sinais: hazard, risk, slippery, flammable, high voltage, restricted area, no entry, keep clear
Procedimentos: permit to work, JSA/JHA, LOTO (lockout/tagout), confined space, working at height, hot work
Reportar: near miss, incident, injury, first aid, unsafe act, unsafe condition, stop work authority
Emergência: alarm, evacuate, muster point, headcount, fire extinguisher, assembly area

60 HSE vocabulary cards (part of the ~240 core cards)
Mini-dialogue: 'safety induction' with Portuguese translation
5-question quiz per lesson with answers

modules.title: Módulo 2: Toolbox Talk e Instruções no Terreno
modules.goal: Understand short site briefings and instructions, handle numbers, times and shifts, and safely ask for repetition or say something is unsafe.
lessons: Como é uma toolbox talk: estrutura e frases que se repetem todos os dias
Ordens e instruções (imperativos): lift, hold, move, stop, check, wait, report
Números, medidas, horas e turnos: shift, day/night shift, overtime, metres, kilograms, 'at 0600'
Pedir para repetir e confirmar: 'Sorry, can you say that again?', 'Let me confirm...'
Dizer 'não é seguro' com confiança: 'I think this is not safe. Can we stop and check?'
deliverables: Toolbox talk script with translation and comprehension questions
'Frases de sobrevivência no terreno' 1-page cheat sheet
Numbers and times practice sheet

modules.title: Módulo 3: Rádio, Telefone e Comunicação Curta

lessons: Alfabeto fonético (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie...): soletrar o nome, a matrícula e o número de trabalhador
Palavras de rádio: copy, roger, over, say again, standby, affirmative, negative, radio check
Chamadas telefónicas simples: atender, transferir, deixar recado, confirmar horário
Mensagens curtas de trabalho (SMS/WhatsApp): atraso, ausência, confirmação, pedido de material

Read 15-20 real public job ads from official company or contractor channels and note the recurring English words. Do NOT copy the ads; use them only to collect vocabulary.
Run Claude Prompt 1 (outline + style guide). Edit the outline and save it as your master document in Google Docs.
Create the brand basics in Canva free: navy #0B2545 + safety orange #F28C28, one font, text logo 'Turno 15'.

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 1: Master outline and style guide
claude_prompts.prompt:
You are an instructional designer and ESL teacher who specialises in workplace English for the oil & gas, LNG construction and mining supply chain. Your learners are Mozambicans whose first language is Portuguese, with English between zero and A2. They study only on cheap Android phones with limited mobile data.

2. Write a style guide for the whole product: explanations in Mozambican Portuguese (European spelling as used in Mozambique, e.g. 'acção', 'projecto', 'correcto'; Mozambican vocabulary such as 'telemóvel', 'candidatura', 'vaga', 'machimbombo', 'descarregar', 'ecrã'; verb forms for 'você' without repeating the word 'você' in every sentence; no Brazilianisms such as 'celular', 'baixar', 'tela', 'time' for equipa or gerunds like 'estou fazendo'), short sentences, max 3 columns per table, mobile-friendly formatting, and approximate pronunciation written for Portuguese speakers (e.g. 'hazard' = 'RÉ-zârd').

15. After launch: withdraw your balance after every sale or at least daily (the company claims same-day payout, so confirm it yourself). Keep a record of every withdrawal.
16. Keep your own buyer list (name, phone, email, product, date, consent to messages) in a private Google Sheet. Never rely only on the platform.
17. Refunds: honour every refund request made within 7 days, through the platform's process, without arguing. Remove refunded buyers from the group and the members area if possible.
18. Whenever the price, contents or cohort date change, update the EscalePay product and the Lovable pages on the same day so they never contradict each other.

affiliate_program.why: 40% (about 279 MT per 697 MT sale, if calculated on the full price) is high enough to motivate admins of job-vacancy Facebook pages, WhatsApp groups and TikTok creators, who have the exact audience and are the main growth engine when you have no audience yourself. After the platform fee you still net about 330-348 MT per affiliate sale, plus any order bump and upsell profit. The upsell and downsell are personal services that take your time, so leave them out of the commission if the platform allows per-product settings. Approve affiliates manually where possible and remove anyone who promises jobs, invents testimonials or spams.
materials: Affiliate rules (1 page, Portuguese): what they may say; what is FORBIDDEN ('emprego garantido', 'vaga certa', 'vaga na TotalEnergies/Exxon', income claims, 'nº 1'/'mais vendido' claims, fake testimonials, company logos, uniforms or site photos, fake deadlines, spam in groups without the admin's permission); mandatory line: 'Produto independente de preparação. Não garante emprego.'
5 WhatsApp Status images (1080x1920) with ready captions: HSE word of the day, radio alphabet, CV tip, anti-scam sign, product overview with price 697 MT.
3 short video scripts (30-45 s) with hooks, for TikTok/Reels/Status, that affiliates can record in their own voice.
10 ready-to-copy posts and captions in Mozambican Portuguese (for Facebook groups/pages and WhatsApp), each ending with the mandatory line and a space for their affiliate link.
Pinned-post template for vacancy-page admins: 'Antes de se candidatar, prepare o seu inglês e proteja-se de burlas'.
The free 'Checklist Anti-Burla: 12 Sinais de Vaga Falsa' image to share as genuine value for their audience.
FAQ and objection answers (job guarantee, delivery, data use, refunds, payment by M-Pesa/e-Mola).
60-second screen-recording demo of the product (members area, PDF, cards, templates).
Cohort calendar (real start dates) so affiliates can use honest deadlines.
Short how-to on getting their affiliate link in EscalePay, how the commission is calculated (gross or net) and how refunds affect it, as confirmed in your dashboard.
A small WhatsApp group for affiliates where you share new materials and weekly tips.

launch_plan.day_range: Launch days 1-2 (after the 7-day production): foundation and pre-launch
actions: Set up TikTok, Instagram and a Facebook page under one name (e.g. 'Turno 15 · Inglês de Trabalho'), with a clear bio: 'Inglês de trabalho para o gás e a mineração. Independente. Não vendemos vagas.' Put the Lovable link in the bio.
Publish 1-2 educational videos per day (content ideas 1-4) and 3 WhatsApp Status posts per day (daily card + anti-scam tip + one soft offer).
Launch the free 'Checklist Anti-Burla' via the /anti-burla page. People message you on WhatsApp and you send the checklist. Save contacts only with permission.
Message 20 people in your network personally (not copy-paste spam): explain the product and ask whether they know someone who needs it.

Contact 15-20 admins of job-vacancy Facebook pages and WhatsApp groups, technical school alumni groups and youth associations. Offer the free checklist for their members and invite them to become affiliates at 40%.
Join relevant Facebook groups and post only where the rules allow. Lead with value (a vocabulary or anti-scam post), not the sales link.
Announce the first cohort date honestly: 'A Turma 1 do grupo de prática começa no dia [DATA].'
Post a short 'por dentro do kit' preview (screen recording of the PDF and cards), without testimonials yet.

launch_plan.day_range: Launch days 5-7: open sales and live teaching
actions: Do a free 20-30 minute TikTok or Facebook live: '10 palavras de segurança que se ouvem muito no terreno'. Answer questions and mention the kit at the end.
Post the full 'por dentro do kit' screen recording showing the PDF, cards and templates.
Reply to every comment and DM within a few hours. Send interested people the page link and answer objections with the FAQ.
Every evening: withdraw sales, add buyers to the group, update the buyer sheet.

launch_plan.day_range: Launch days 8-10: affiliate push and objections
actions: Send all affiliates the full materials pack and do a 15-minute voice-note mini-training in the affiliates group.
Post objection-busting content: 'Isto garante emprego? Não, e desconfie de quem garante', 'Como recebo depois de pagar com M-Pesa', 'Gasta muitos dados?'.
Do a second live: 'Simulação de entrevista em inglês'. Practise 'Tell me about yourself' with viewers.
Repost the strongest-performing video with a new hook.

If beta testers or buyers gave written permission after at least 7 days of use, share their real opinions about the PRODUCT (clarity, usefulness), and say if they received the kit for free. Never about jobs.
Share (with permission) real voice-note progress from group members, about learning only.
Post a before/after of a FICTIONAL CV example to show the upsell service, clearly labelled as an example.
Remind people of the real cohort registration deadline.

launch_plan.day_range: Launch days 13-14: close the cohort and review
actions: Last call for Turma 1 (honest deadline), then actually close registrations for that group and announce the next cohort date.
Start the cohort: welcome message, rules, Day 1 challenge.
Review your metrics: which hooks brought clicks, which affiliates sold, the page conversion rate and refund reasons. Adjust the headline, price test or content angle for the next 14 days.
Ask buyers for honest feedback through a simple Google Form.

content_ideas.hook: Se o supervisor gritar 'STOP WORK!', sabe o que fazer?
content_ideas.outline: Explain 'stop work authority' in simple Portuguese. Teach 3 related phrases ('Stop work', 'It's not safe', 'Let's check') with pronunciation. Remind viewers that the employer's procedures come first. End with: the full HSE vocabulary is in the kit (link in bio).

content_ideas.hook: Quem pede dinheiro para dar emprego não é recrutador. É burla.
content_ideas.outline: Show 4 of the 12 warning signs of fake job offers using fictional example messages. Offer the free Checklist Anti-Burla via the /anti-burla link. No sales pitch, pure value.

content_ideas.hook: 'Near miss' NÃO quer dizer 'quase falhou'.
content_ideas.outline: Explain the term (an event that almost caused harm and must be reported). Add 2 more false friends. Ask viewers to comment a work word they do not understand.

content_ideas.hook: Como se diz '12ª classe' num CV em inglês? Muita gente erra.
content_ideas.outline: Show an honest translation, then técnico médio and licenciatura. Show one wrong vs right CV line. CTA: 3 CV templates in the kit.

content_ideas.hook: Diga isto quando não perceber o inglês do seu chefe.
content_ideas.outline: Teach 4 polite phrases: 'Sorry, can you say that again?', 'Can you speak slowly, please?', 'Let me confirm...', 'Can you show me?'. Explain why asking is safer than guessing on site.

content_ideas.hook: Soletre o seu nome como no rádio do terreno. Eu começo: T de Tango, U de Uniform, R de Romeo, N de November, O de Oscar.
content_ideas.outline: Teach the phonetic alphabet with on-screen text. Invite viewers to comment their name in the alphabet, which drives engagement. Mention the Cartão de Bolso de Rádio e Emergência.

content_ideas.hook: 'Tell me about yourself': a resposta em 4 partes para não ficar calado.
content_ideas.outline: Give a simple 4-part structure (name and city, experience, skill, motivation) with a fictional example in English + translation. Remind viewers to say only true facts. CTA: 40-question interview bank in the kit.

content_ideas.hook: Dia 1 de 30: aprenda comigo, 15 minutos por dia.
content_ideas.outline: A daily card image + a 20-second voice note with 5 words. Builds the habit, shows the method and leads to the full kit and group.

content_ideas.hook: 5 palavras de segurança que se ouvem muito nas toolbox talks.
content_ideas.outline: Carousel or text post: PPE, hazard, permit to work, muster point, near miss, each with pronunciation and meaning. End with the disclaimer and the link to the free checklist or the kit.

content_ideas.hook: Como estudar inglês todos os dias com poucos dados. Mostro como.
content_ideas.outline: Show the low-data routine: download once on Wi-Fi, study the files offline, send short voice notes. Honest and practical, and it answers the 'no data' objection.

content_ideas.hook: 3 coisas que nunca deve enviar a um 'recrutador' no WhatsApp.
content_ideas.outline: BI photo to unknown numbers, NUIT, M-Pesa PIN or codes. Explain why with fictional examples. CTA: free Checklist Anti-Burla.

content_ideas.hook: O alfabeto do rádio em 30 segundos: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie...
content_ideas.outline: Fast on-screen alphabet with pronunciation hints for Portuguese speakers, then one radio phrase ('Radio check, over'). CTA: Cartão de Bolso in the kit.

metrics.metric: Sales page visit -> checkout click rate
metrics.target: 8-15% (starting target to adjust, not a market statistic)
metrics.why: Shows whether the headline, offer and price are convincing. Below 5%, rewrite the hero and FAQ.

metrics.target: 35-55% (starting target)
metrics.why: M-Pesa/e-Mola confirmation failures and hesitation happen at checkout. Low numbers mean you should follow up by WhatsApp and check checkout clarity.

metrics.target: 20-30% of buyers (starting target)
metrics.why: Tells you whether the audio pack is seen as useful. Adjust its wording or price if it stays low.

metrics.target: 5-10% upsell; 5-10% of those who decline take the downsell (starting targets)
metrics.why: These services are where the margin is. Also track hours spent per client so you never sell more than your real weekly capacity.

metrics.target: 15-40 sales (starting target for a creator with no audience)
metrics.why: A realistic first goal. It shows whether the offer works before you think about any EscalePay ranking.

metrics.target: Under 8% (starting target)
metrics.why: High refunds signal that expectations do not match the product or that delivery is failing. Read every refund reason.

metrics.metric: Group engagement: share of members sending at least 1 voice note per week
metrics.target: 30-40% (starting target)
metrics.why: People who practise get value, recommend the product and rarely ask for refunds.

metrics.metric: Active affiliates (at least 1 sale) by day 30
metrics.target: 5-10 (starting target)
metrics.why: Affiliates are your scale engine without ads and, if EscalePay ranks products by sales (unverified), the main lever for appearing among its best sellers.

metrics.why: Consistency builds the audience. Reuse the winning hooks in new videos and in the affiliate materials.

metrics.metric: Free checklist leads (WhatsApp contacts with consent)
metrics.target: 100+ in 14 days (starting target)

compliance: Never promise or suggest jobs, interviews, hiring, income or salary. Banned phrases include 'emprego garantido', 'vaga certa', 'vais ser contratado' and 'ganhe X MT por mês'.
Never claim a ranking ('nº 1', 'top 1', 'mais vendido', 'trending') unless EscalePay publicly shows it at that moment; if it does, show the date and a real screenshot.

Make it clear everywhere (sales page, checkout description, PDF cover, group rules, affiliate rules) that the product is independent and NOT affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to TotalEnergies, Mozambique LNG, ExxonMobil, Rovuma LNG, ENH, INP, any mining company, contractor or government entity. Do not use their logos, photos of their sites or uniforms.

Never sell, promise or 'facilitate' access to vacancies, and never accept money for job placement. The product is education and document preparation only. Do not use the word 'vagas' for your service capacity; say 'lugares'.

The safety vocabulary is language learning. State that it does not replace official safety training, site inductions, medical exams or professional certifications, and that the employer's procedures always come first.

Testimonials must be real, voluntary, given with written permission and about the product (clarity, usefulness, practice). Never invent them, never edit their meaning, say when the person received the kit for free, and never use testimonials that imply a job was obtained thanks to the product. Do not invent numbers, buyer counts or biographies.

Use honest scarcity only: real cohort start dates, real upsell capacity, and a launch price that actually ends on the announced date. No fake countdown timers, no fake 'only 3 left', no 'only on this page' unless it is true.
Do not state unverified platform features to buyers as facts (same-day payout, 1-click upsell, members area). Describe only what you confirmed in your own test purchase.
Honour the 7-day refund policy for every product without making it hard, and describe exactly what the buyer receives and how delivery works.

Data protection: collect only the data needed. For the CV services, ask for consent, do not request BI/NUIT numbers, remove sensitive data before using Claude, store files privately, delete CVs and form data 30 days after delivery and tell clients this. Publish a plain-language privacy policy.

WhatsApp group: tell members their phone number is visible to others, use a Community with an admin-only announcements group, ban members who post job scams, fake vacancies or requests for money, and never share members' data with third parties.
Marketing messages: contact only people who gave permission or reached out first, post in groups only where the admins allow it, and offer an easy way to stop messages ('SAIR').
Never ask buyers to pay to a personal M-Pesa/e-Mola number. All payments go through the EscalePay checkout.
Affiliates must follow the same rules. Approve affiliates manually where possible, give them the forbidden-claims list and remove anyone who breaks it.

Content accuracy and copyright: verify HSE terms against reputable public sources, never copy company documents, job ads or paid course materials word for word, and use fictional names in all examples.
Do not imitate any real organisation's branding, and do not present the 'certificado de conclusão do kit' as an official or accredited certificate.
Transparency: say on the page that the content was prepared with the help of AI tools and reviewed by you, if that is the case.
Money and taxes: keep records of sales and withdrawals, and ask an accountant about registering the activity and declaring the income under Mozambican rules.

copy.seo_title: Kit Turno 15: Inglês para o Gás e a Mineração | 697 MT
copy.meta_description: Inglês de segurança, terreno e entrevista no telemóvel, 15 min por dia. Modelos de CV e carta, guia anti-burla e grupo de prática. M-Pesa ou e-Mola.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: Say in a few seconds what the product is, who it is for and what it costs, and get the first click, without promising jobs.
sections.headline: Inglês de trabalho para o sector do gás e da mineração, no seu telemóvel, em 15 minutos por dia.
sections.subheadline: Aprenda o inglês de segurança, do terreno e da entrevista, e prepare o seu CV e a sua carta em inglês com modelos prontos a adaptar. Um plano de 30 dias. Preparação real, sem promessas falsas.
sections.body:
Para moçambicanos que conhecem o trabalho, mas travam quando o chefe, o formulário ou o recrutador fala inglês.

Pagamento por M-Pesa ou e-Mola · Acesso imediato · Garantia de 7 dias
bullets: Inglês de segurança (HSE), de terreno e de rádio
3 modelos de CV e 2 modelos de carta em inglês, para adaptar ao seu percurso
40 perguntas de entrevista com respostas modelo e tradução
Guia para reconhecer vagas falsas e proteger o seu dinheiro
Gasta poucos dados: descarrega uma vez e estuda os ficheiros sem internet
sections.design_notes: Above the hero, a thin full-width notice bar (light grey #F4F5F7, navy text, 13-14px): 'Produto independente. Não somos agência de recrutamento e não vendemos vagas.' Hero background navy #0B2545, white text, headline 26-30px on mobile, bold. CTA button safety orange #F28C28 with NAVY bold text (white on this orange fails contrast), full width on mobile, at least 48px tall, links to {{LINK_CHECKOUT_PRINCIPAL}}. Put the payment microcopy line directly under the button in small light-grey text. Keep 'Acesso imediato' only if your test purchase confirmed it. Image: a phone mockup showing one Turno 15 vocabulary card (your own Canva design). No company logos, no photos of real LNG/mining sites, no branded uniforms. Compress the image to WebP under 80 KB. Sticky bottom bar on mobile with the button 'Comprar por 697 MT', shown after the user scrolls past the hero.

sections.name: Problema
sections.purpose: Show the reader that we understand their real situation, using the avatar's pains in their own words.
sections.headline: Conhece o trabalho, mas o inglês trava-o?
sections.subheadline: Se se revê em pelo menos uma destas situações, este kit foi feito para si.
sections.body:
Tem a 12ª classe, um curso técnico ou anos de experiência prática. Sabe fazer o trabalho.

Mas quando a conversa passa para inglês, tudo fica mais difícil. Não é falta de capacidade. É falta de prática com as palavras certas.
bullets: Quando o supervisor fala inglês, fica calado com medo de errar.
Não percebe bem as palavras de segurança da toolbox talk, dos sinais e dos formulários.
O seu CV está só em português, ou é uma tradução que não sabe se está correcta.
Nunca treinou uma entrevista em inglês em voz alta.
Já viu alguém perder dinheiro com uma 'vaga' que pedia taxa de inscrição, farda ou processamento.
Os cursos de inglês são caros, ficam longe, têm horários fixos e gastam muitos dados.
sections.design_notes: Light grey background #F4F5F7. Headline in navy. Each bullet as a short row with a small orange line icon (outline circle or dash, not an emoji). Short paragraphs, font at least 16px. The CTA is a text link that scrolls to the offer section (#oferta), not a big button, so the page does not feel pushy this early.

sections.name: História (placeholder honesto)
sections.purpose: Build trust with the creator's REAL reason for making the kit. This must be filled in with true facts only.
sections.headline: Porque criei este kit
sections.subheadline: [UMA FRASE REAL SOBRE SI. Ex.: o que viu acontecer na sua família, no seu bairro ou na sua cidade.]
sections.body:
[ESCREVA AQUI A SUA HISTÓRIA REAL EM 3 A 5 FRASES CURTAS. Não invente nada. Responda com factos verdadeiros:]

[1. Quem é? Nome, idade, cidade.]

[2. Qual é a sua relação com o inglês? Como aprendeu e onde o usa.]

[3. O que viu que o levou a criar este kit? Ex.: alguém próximo que travou numa entrevista ou que perdeu dinheiro numa vaga falsa. Só escreva isto se for verdade.]

[4. Porque decidiu fazer um produto honesto, sem promessas de emprego?]

Este kit não é magia. É prática diária, com as palavras certas, no seu telemóvel.
sections.design_notes: Controlled by SHOW_STORY in the Lovable config: keep it false until the story is written. Simple text block on white, max width 640px, generous line height. Optional real photo of the creator (your own photo, never a stock photo presented as you). Delete every bracketed instruction before publishing. If you prefer, put your story only in 'Sobre o criador' and leave this section off, rather than repeating it. The CTA is a text link that scrolls to #modulos.

sections.name: Ponto de viragem / Solução
sections.purpose: Explain, factually and neutrally, why now is a good time to prepare, then introduce the kit as the practical answer, with no job promises.
sections.headline: O sector está a mexer. A sua preparação também pode.
sections.subheadline: Não precisa de ser fluente. Precisa de dominar o inglês que se usa no trabalho, no CV e na entrevista.
sections.body:
Em Janeiro de 2026 foram retomadas as obras de um dos grandes projectos de gás natural em Cabo Delgado. E a nova Lei de Conteúdo Local, de 2026, torna obrigatório o recurso a empresas e trabalhadores nacionais no sector do petróleo e gás.

Nestes projectos usa-se português e inglês. Quem entende as instruções de segurança, tem um CV claro em inglês e consegue responder numa entrevista chega mais bem preparado.

**Atenção:** estar preparado não é o mesmo que ter emprego garantido. Ninguém honesto lhe pode garantir uma vaga. Este kit prepara-o para que, quando surgir uma vaga verdadeira, o inglês não seja o motivo de ficar de fora.

Foi para isso que criei o **Kit Turno 15**: o inglês do terreno, do CV e da entrevista, num plano de 30 dias pensado para o telemóvel.
bullets: Inglês específico do sector, não inglês genérico
Começa do zero, com pronúncia escrita para quem fala português
Feito para telemóveis simples e poucos dados
Inclui CV, carta, entrevista e protecção contra burlas
sections.design_notes: White background. Neutral, factual tone: no company names, no logos, no photos of real sites, no maps of concession areas. Optional simple illustration (hard hat + phone) in the brand colours. Before publishing, confirm the news and the law against reliable public sources and keep the wording neutral; update this paragraph if the situation changes. The 'Atenção' paragraph sits in a soft orange box (#FFF4E8) with a navy left border. CTA links to {{LINK_CHECKOUT_PRINCIPAL}}.

sections.name: Mecanismo: Método Turno 15
sections.purpose: Make the method concrete and believable: what happens every day, for how long and why it works.
sections.headline: Método Turno 15: Reconhecer, Repetir, Responder
sections.subheadline: Um 'turno' de 15 minutos por dia, em três blocos de 5 minutos.
sections.body:
Cada dia é como um pequeno turno de trabalho. Curto, claro e com uma tarefa no fim.

**1. Reconhecer (5 min):** lê um cartão com 5 a 8 palavras ou frases de trabalho, com o significado e a pronúncia aproximada escrita para quem fala português. Exemplo: hazard = RÉ-zârd (perigo).

**2. Repetir (5 min):** diz cada palavra e a frase de exemplo em voz alta, 3 vezes. Falar todos os dias dá mais confiança do que só ler.

**3. Responder (5 min):** faz um desafio real. Por exemplo, enviar uma nota de voz a responder a uma pergunta de supervisor, escrever uma linha de um relatório de incidente ou responder a uma pergunta de entrevista. Depois publica-o no grupo de prática.

Cada semana tem um tema do trabalho real, para que uma coisa leve à outra. E há um registo de progresso para marcar cada dia concluído.
bullets: Semana 1: Segurança (HSE)
Semana 2: Terreno, números e rádio
Semana 3: Formulários, emails, CV e carta
Semana 4: Entrevista em inglês
Dias 29-30: Revisão geral e simulação final de entrevista
sections.design_notes: Three step cards stacked on mobile (side by side on desktop), each with a large orange number in a navy circle, the step name in bold and '5 min' as a small tag. Below, a simple vertical timeline for the 4 weeks + days 29-30. Show one real daily card image (scaled down, WebP under 60 KB). CTA links to {{LINK_CHECKOUT_PRINCIPAL}}.

sections.name: O que vai aprender (módulos)
sections.purpose: Show the depth and practicality of the content, module by module.
sections.headline: O que vai aprender: 10 módulos práticos
sections.subheadline: Do primeiro dia de segurança até à simulação de entrevista.
sections.body: Toque em cada módulo para ver o que inclui. Explicações em português de Moçambique, com os termos de trabalho em inglês, tal como os vai ouvir.
bullets: Módulo 0: Comece Aqui. Como usar o kit no telemóvel, teste de nível com 20 perguntas, como poupar dados e o aviso honesto sobre o que o kit faz e não faz.
Módulo 1: Inglês de Segurança (HSE). EPI (PPE), perigos e sinais, permit to work, near miss, stop work authority, alarme, evacuação e muster point.
Módulo 2: Toolbox Talk e Instruções no Terreno. Ordens, números, medidas, horas e turnos, como pedir para repetir e como dizer 'isto não é seguro'.
Módulo 3: Rádio, Telefone e Comunicação Curta. Alfabeto fonético, palavras de rádio, chamadas simples e mensagens de trabalho por SMS ou WhatsApp.
Módulo 4: Inglês por Função (8 Áreas de Trabalho). Vocabulário-chave para construção e andaimes, logística e armazém, motoristas, catering e acampamento, segurança, HSE, técnicos e administração.
Módulo 5: Emails, Formulários e Relatórios Simples. Fichas de admissão e indução, timesheet, relatório de incidente simples e 10 emails modelo.
Módulo 6: CV e Carta de Apresentação em Inglês. 3 modelos de CV, 2 modelos de carta e como traduzir correctamente a 12ª classe, o técnico médio e a carta de condução.
Módulo 7: Entrevista em Inglês. 'Tell me about yourself' em 60 segundos, 40 perguntas com respostas modelo, perguntas de segurança e o método SAR (Situação, Acção, Resultado).
Módulo 8: Vaga Verdadeira ou Burla? 12 sinais de vaga falsa, como verificar uma vaga e como proteger o seu BI, NUIT e dinheiro.
Módulo 9: Plano Turno 15 (30 Dias). Calendário de 30 dias, 30 cartões diários para o WhatsApp e registo de progresso.
sections.design_notes: Section id 'modulos'. Accordion with native <details>/<summary>, all items collapsed, module number in an orange tag, title in bold navy, the description visible when opened. Module titles must match the PDF exactly. CTA under the accordion links to {{LINK_CHECKOUT_PRINCIPAL}}.

sections.name: Bónus
sections.purpose: Add real value, especially the guided practice group, which turns a PDF into an experience.
sections.headline: 4 bónus incluídos
sections.subheadline: Para praticar com outras pessoas, proteger-se de burlas e ter o vocabulário certo sempre à mão.
sections.body: Os bónus estão incluídos nos 697 MT. Não paga nada a mais por eles.
bullets: Bónus 1: Grupo de Prática no WhatsApp (30 Dias). Todos os dias recebe o desafio Turno 15 (texto, imagem e nota de voz). Responde com uma nota de voz no grupo de prática e recebe comentários em grupo várias vezes por semana. A próxima turma começa no dia [data real da próxima turma].
Bónus 2: Checklist Anti-Burla (12 Sinais de Vaga Falsa). Os 12 sinais de vaga falsa numa página, para guardar no telemóvel e partilhar com a família.
Bónus 3: Cartão de Bolso de Rádio e Emergência. A versão de bolso do Módulo 3: alfabeto fonético, palavras de rádio e 15 frases de segurança numa só página.
Bónus 4: Dicionários de Bolso por Função (8 Áreas). A versão de bolso do Módulo 4: uma página com o vocabulário-chave de cada área de trabalho. Escolha a sua.
sections.cta_text: Quero o kit com os 4 bónus
sections.design_notes: Four cards in one column on mobile (2x2 on desktop), white cards on light grey, each with a small line icon, the bonus name in bold and 1-2 lines of text. Do not show inflated 'valor' prices next to the bonuses. The cohort date comes from NEXT_COHORT_DATE in the config and must be a real date you will honour. CTA links to {{LINK_CHECKOUT_PRINCIPAL}}.

sections.name: Como funciona (3 passos)
sections.purpose: Remove fear about paying and receiving, especially for buyers who have been scammed before or never bought online.
sections.headline: Como funciona a compra

faq.q: Isto garante emprego?
faq.a: Não. Este kit prepara-o: inglês de trabalho, CV, carta e entrevista. Nenhum produto honesto pode garantir emprego. E é exactamente por isso que o Módulo 8 ensina a fugir de quem 'garante' vagas a troco de dinheiro.

faq.q: É afiliado à TotalEnergies, à ExxonMobil ou a outra empresa?
faq.a: Não. É um produto independente, sem ligação a nenhuma empresa, projecto, empreiteiro ou entidade do governo. Não somos agência de recrutamento e não vendemos vagas.

faq.a: Serve. O kit começa do zero e cada palavra tem a pronúncia aproximada escrita para quem fala português. Comece pelo teste de nível do Módulo 0 e siga o plano dia a dia.

faq.q: Preciso de computador?
faq.a: Não. Tudo funciona no telemóvel: os PDFs abrem em qualquer leitor de PDF e os modelos de CV abrem no Google Docs ou no Word do telemóvel. Se quiser imprimir o CV, pode usar uma reprografia.

faq.a: Pouco. Descarrega os ficheiros uma vez (o kit principal tem cerca de [TAMANHO REAL] MB), de preferência com Wi-Fi, e depois estuda sem internet. No grupo, o conteúdo diário é um texto, uma imagem e uma nota de voz curta.

faq.q: Como recebo o kit depois de pagar?
faq.a: O acesso chega logo depois do pagamento, na área de membros ou por link [confirme na sua compra de teste e escreva aqui o método real]. O link do grupo de prática no WhatsApp está dentro da área de acesso. Se tiver algum problema, fale connosco no WhatsApp de suporte.

faq.q: Posso pagar com M-Pesa ou e-Mola?
faq.a: Sim. O pagamento é feito na página de pagamento da EscalePay, com M-Pesa ou e-Mola. Não precisa de cartão bancário. Confirma o pagamento no seu telemóvel. Nunca pedimos pagamentos para números pessoais.

faq.q: Quando começa o grupo de prática?
faq.a: As turmas começam em datas fixas. A próxima começa no dia [data real da próxima turma]. Se comprar depois dessa data, entra na turma seguinte e pode começar já a estudar o kit sozinho. Atenção: num grupo de WhatsApp, o seu número fica visível para os outros membros.

faq.q: Os áudios de pronúncia estão incluídos?
faq.a: Não estão incluídos no preço do kit. Os Áudios de Pronúncia Turno 15 são um extra opcional de 147 MT, que pode adicionar na página de pagamento antes de pagar. O kit funciona sem eles: a pronúncia aproximada está escrita em cada cartão e há notas de voz diárias no grupo.

faq.q: E se eu não gostar?
faq.a: Tem garantia de reembolso de 7 dias, de acordo com a política da EscalePay. Peça o reembolso dentro desse prazo e o seu pedido será respeitado.

faq.q: Recebo um certificado?
faq.a: Recebe um certificado de conclusão do kit, para sua motivação. Não é um certificado oficial nem acreditado, e não substitui formações ou certificações de segurança.

faq.q: Há vídeos no YouTube grátis. Porque pagar?
faq.a: Há, e muitos são bons. Mas estão espalhados e quase nunca são sobre o nosso sector. Aqui tem o vocabulário de segurança e de terreno, o CV, a carta, a entrevista e o guia anti-burla num só plano de 30 dias, com um grupo para praticar a falar.

disclaimers: O Kit Turno 15 é um produto digital de aprendizagem de inglês e preparação de documentos. Não garante emprego, entrevistas, contratação, salário nem qualquer rendimento.
Os resultados dependem do esforço, da prática diária e da situação de cada pessoa. 30 dias de 15 minutos por dia dão uma base de inglês de trabalho, não fluência.

Produto independente: não tem ligação, patrocínio nem aprovação da TotalEnergies, Mozambique LNG, ExxonMobil, Rovuma LNG, ENH, INP, de nenhuma empresa mineira, empreiteiro, projecto ou entidade do governo. Os nomes de empresas e projectos são referidos apenas como informação pública.
Não somos agência de recrutamento. Não vendemos, prometemos nem facilitamos o acesso a vagas, e nunca pedimos dinheiro para conseguir emprego.

O vocabulário de segurança (HSE) serve apenas para aprender inglês. Não substitui formações oficiais de segurança, induções no local de trabalho, exames médicos nem certificações profissionais. Os procedimentos do seu empregador vêm sempre primeiro.
O 'certificado de conclusão do kit' é um registo pessoal de progresso. Não é um certificado oficial nem acreditado.
Garantia de reembolso de 7 dias para todos os produtos (kit, Áudios de Pronúncia Turno 15, Revisão Pessoal: CV + Carta em Inglês e Revisão Rápida do CV), de acordo com a política da EscalePay.

Os serviços Revisão Pessoal: CV + Carta em Inglês e Revisão Rápida do CV melhoram a apresentação dos seus documentos, mas não garantem emprego. Nunca inventamos experiência, certificados ou datas. Confirme todos os factos antes de enviar o seu CV.

Privacidade: recolhemos apenas os dados necessários para entregar o produto e os serviços. Não pedimos o número do BI nem o NUIT. CVs e dados de formulários são apagados 30 dias depois da entrega. Pode pedir a eliminação dos seus dados a qualquer momento pelo contacto de suporte.
Grupo de Prática no WhatsApp: o seu número de telemóvel fica visível para os outros membros. Membros que publiquem vagas, pedidos de dinheiro ou spam são removidos.
Depoimentos, quando existirem, são reais, voluntários, publicados com autorização escrita e referem-se ao produto. Não representam resultados típicos nem garantem resultados.
As datas e os lugares limitados indicados nesta página são reais: datas de início das turmas e capacidade semanal dos serviços de revisão. Não usamos contadores falsos.
O conteúdo foi preparado com o apoio de ferramentas de inteligência artificial e revisto pelo criador [mantenha esta frase só se for verdade].
Os pagamentos são processados pela EscalePay através de M-Pesa ou e-Mola. Nunca envie dinheiro para números pessoais em nome deste produto.

lovable.overview: Lovable build pack for the Kit Turno 15 funnel ("Inglês para o Gás e a Mineração", 697 MT, with a 147 MT order bump and a 1.497 MT upsell). You paste 8 prompts into Lovable one at a time. Together they build a mobile-first React site with these routes: / (sales page with 15 sections and the reviewed Portuguese copy, word for word), /obrigado (thank-you page), /oferta-especial (upsell: YES goes to the upsell checkout, NO goes to /obrigado), /afiliados (affiliate programme, 40%), /privacidade and /termos (simple, honest legal texts with the full disclaimers), and a small /anti-burla lead page so the footer link is never broken. How the funnel flows: the sales page sends buyers to EscalePay checkout (M-Pesa/e-Mola, order bump set up inside EscalePay). After payment, if EscalePay lets you set a redirect, the buyer lands on /oferta-especial. YES opens a separate EscalePay checkout for the Revisão Pessoal. NO goes to /obrigado?upsell=nao. Links and real facts live in one file, src/config.ts: checkout URLs, WhatsApp number, cohort date, kit size, delivery days and so on. On/off switches (SHOW_STORY, SHOW_TESTIMONIALS, SHOW_LAUNCH_PRICE and others) control the optional or unverified blocks. Text in square brackets still waiting for a real value is highlighted in yellow in the preview, so nothing unfinished goes live. Ethics are built into the code: no countdown timers, no fake prices, no invented testimonials, a 'not a recruitment agency' notice on every page, and the full legal notice visible in the footer. Expect the build to take about 8 main messages plus 2-6 fix messages. Prompt 2 is the largest. If Lovable stops partway through, use fix prompt 'Lovable stopped halfway'.
before_you_start: ESCALEPAY FIRST (Lovable comes after): finish identity verification (KYC) so your account is active. Create 3 products: (1) 'Kit Turno 15' at 697 MT, (2) 'Revisão Pessoal: CV + Carta em Inglês' at 1.497 MT as a separate product, (3) optional 'Revisão Rápida do CV' at 597 MT for the WhatsApp follow-up. Copy the public checkout link of (1) and (2). These become ESCALEPAY_CHECKOUT_URL and ESCALEPAY_UPSELL_URL.

Set up the ORDER BUMP inside EscalePay on the main product (the Lovable page does not handle it). Headline exactly: 'Sim, quero ouvir como se diz (+147 MT)'. Text exactly: 'Adicione os Áudios de Pronúncia Turno 15: 30 áudios curtos (um por dia do plano) e a pronúncia de cerca de 200 palavras-chave de segurança, terreno e entrevista, em ficheiros leves para o telemóvel. Ouça, repita e ganhe confiança para falar. Por mais 147 MT. Também coberto pela garantia de 7 dias.' Upload the audio files as the bump's content.

In EscalePay, check 3 things and write the answers down: (a) can you set a 'redirect after purchase / thank-you URL'? If yes, use https://YOUR-SITE/oferta-especial for the main product and https://YOUR-SITE/obrigado for the upsell product. If no, put the /obrigado link in the access area and in your welcome WhatsApp message. (b) Exactly how buyers receive access (members area or link). (c) The exact refund process and the affiliate rules: is the commission calculated on the full price, and do refunded sales pay commission? These answers replace the yellow placeholders.

Affiliates: turn on affiliation for the main product at 40% and copy the affiliate invite/sign-up link if EscalePay gives one (this becomes ESCALEPAY_AFFILIATE_URL). If there is no public link, leave it empty and the button opens WhatsApp instead.

Do one TEST PURCHASE with your own M-Pesa before you announce anything: buy the kit plus the bump, confirm how access arrives, check that the payout reaches your M-Pesa/e-Mola, then try the refund request. Only keep 'Acesso imediato' on the page if access really was immediate (otherwise set SHOW_ACESSO_IMEDIATO = false). After launch, withdraw after every sale and copy each buyer's name and number into your own spreadsheet.

WhatsApp: use a WhatsApp Business number. Write it in two forms: digits only for links (258XXXXXXXXX, no + and no spaces) and a readable form for display (e.g. +258 84 123 4567). Decide your real support hours, e.g. 'de segunda a sábado, das 8h às 20h'.

Real facts to have ready (never invent them): the date of the next practice-group cohort and its number (e.g. Turma 1), the date enrolment closes, the real size in MB of the main kit file, your name and city (or business name), the delivery time in working days and the weekly slots for the Revisão Pessoal, and your true 3-5 sentence story if you want the story section.

Images, made in Canva and exported as WebP: hero-telemovel.webp (phone mockup showing ONE of your own vocabulary cards, about 720x1280, under 80 KB), cartao-diario.webp (one real daily card, under 60 KB), og-image.jpg (1200x630, kit name + '697 MT · M-Pesa ou e-Mola', under 300 KB), favicon.png (512x512, simple 'T15' mark), and optionally criador.webp (your own photo, 240x240, under 30 KB). Do not use company logos, photos of LNG or mining sites, branded uniforms or stock photos of people. Compress at squoosh.app.

Create a Google Form for the Revisão Pessoal intake (school, courses, experience, driving licence, target role, email, WhatsApp). Do NOT add BI or NUIT fields. Put the form link in the upsell product's access area in EscalePay.
Pixels (optional): if you have a Meta Pixel ID and/or a TikTok Pixel ID, have them ready. If not, leave them empty. The site works without them.

Before publishing, check the claims in the 'solução' section against reliable public news (the LNG project restarting in January 2026 and the 2026 Local Content Law) and keep the wording neutral. Confirm a current price for an in-person English course before you turn on SHOW_PRICE_COMPARISON.

SAVE CREDITS 1: in Lovable, open Project Settings → Knowledge (Project Knowledge) and paste this once, so you don't have to repeat it: 'This is a Portuguese (Mozambique) sales site. NEVER rewrite, translate, shorten or correct any Portuguese text. Keep spellings like acção, projecto, correctamente. No emojis, no stock photos of people, no company logos, no countdown timers, no fake reviews, no strikethrough prices. Orange #F28C28 buttons always have navy #0B2545 bold text. All links come from src/config.ts. Mobile-first at 360px.'

SAVE CREDITS 2: send ONE prompt per message, exactly as written, and wait until Lovable finishes. Check the preview in mobile view (the phone icon above the preview) before sending the next one. Don't send vague messages like 'make it better'. If a step goes wrong, use the version history to restore the previous version instead of stacking fixes. Put several small fixes in a single message.

SAVE CREDITS 3: for tiny text or colour tweaks, use Lovable's visual edit tool (select an element in the preview and edit it). On many plans simple visual edits use few or no credits, so check yours. To change values in src/config.ts, edit the file in Code view if your plan allows. Otherwise send one message with all the new values together (template in publish_steps).

Plan for credits: the 8 prompts plus a few fixes need roughly 12-20 messages. If you are on the free daily allowance, spread the work over 2-3 days: day 1 prompts 1-3, day 2 prompts 4-6, day 3 prompts 7-8 and the fixes.

fonts: Barlow (Google Fonts, weights 600/700/800): headings, prices, step numbers, wordmark. Condensed industrial feel, like site signage
Source Sans 3 (Google Fonts, weights 400/600/700): body text, bullets, buttons, FAQ. Very readable on cheap Android screens and handles Portuguese accents (ã, ç, ª) cleanly
Load only these weights with display=swap and preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com
style_notes: Concept: 'safety induction card'. The page should feel like a clear, honest, well-printed briefing from a worksite, not a flashy 'make money' page. That helps trust in a niche full of scams.
Signature motif: a 6px hi-vis stripe (45-degree diagonal bands of orange #F28C28 and navy #0B2545) used only twice, at the top of the hero and the top of the final CTA. Don't use it anywhere else.

Mobile-first at 360px: 16px side padding, body text 17px (never under 16px), H1 clamp(26px, 6.5vw, 44px) Barlow 800, H2 clamp(24px, 5.5vw, 36px) Barlow 700, line-height 1.6 for body and 1.15 for headings, text blocks no wider than 680px.
Buttons: orange with navy bold text, 10px radius, at least 52px tall, full width on mobile. Secondary button: 2px navy outline. Every button gets a 3px orange focus ring.
Cards: white, 1px #D9DEE5 border, 12px radius, very soft shadow. The offer card has a 2px navy border and is at most 480px wide, centred.
Icons: lucide-react line icons only (CheckCircle2, X, ShieldCheck, Radio, BookOpen, MessageSquare, Smartphone, Download, MousePointerClick, HardHat). Never emojis.
Section rhythm: alternate white and #F4F5F7, with navy only for hero and final CTA, and the guarantee on soft orange. Vertical padding 56px on mobile, 80px on desktop.

Honesty by design: no countdown timers, no strikethrough 'old prices', no star ratings, no stock photos of people, no company logos or real site photos, no inflated bonus 'valor'. The independence notice bar appears on every page.
Payment trust: write 'M-Pesa' and 'e-Mola' as plain text (use official badges only if EscalePay supplies them). Repeat 'Nunca pedimos pagamentos para números pessoais' near payment information.
Data-light: total page weight under 1 MB, WebP images, no video embeds, no animation libraries. Motion limited to the 200ms slide of the sticky bar, and turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Native <details>/<summary> accordions for modules and FAQ: keyboard accessible, no JavaScript needed, work on old Android browsers.

blueprint.tagline: Transforma o teu WhatsApp numa montra organizada: atende rápido, cobra com segurança e traz o cliente de volta.
blueprint.one_line_pitch: Guia prático em português de Moçambique, com scripts prontos a copiar, respostas rápidas, calendário de Status de 30 dias e modelos Canva, para quem já vende pelo WhatsApp (boutiques, salões, comida, revenda, lojas de bairro) configurar o WhatsApp Business como uma loja, publicar no Status com um plano, conduzir a conversa até à venda e receber por M-Pesa e e-Mola com regras anti-burla.
why_it_can_win: Large, concrete market: many small sellers in Maputo, Matola, Beira, Nampula and Quelimane already sell through WhatsApp (an observation, not a measured statistic), and many use the personal app with no catalogue, no visible prices, no quick replies and no customer list. The pain is daily and visible. Being a top seller on EscalePay is a goal you work towards, not something this plan can promise.

Tangible outcome the buyer can see in hours, not months: a configured profile, a catalogue with prices, greeting/away messages, labels and quick replies. A visible result means a lower refund risk and natural word of mouth.

It is NOT another 'make money online' product. It teaches people who already have a business to organise it, which keeps it away from the scam-saturated niche that Banco de Moçambique has warned about.

Local, specific safety content (fake M-Pesa/e-Mola screenshots, the 'enviei por engano' scam, never sharing PIN or WhatsApp verification codes) is something generic tutorials in Brazilian Portuguese do not cover.
Price (597 MT) sits close to the familiar ~500 MT e-book level, so the decision is easy, while the bundle (scripts, calendar, Canva, Sheets) justifies being slightly above a plain e-book.
The product sells itself through the channel it teaches: every WhatsApp Status, TikTok and Reel the creator publishes is a live demonstration of the method.
Affiliates are a natural fit: sellers know other sellers. Market associations, salon owners and resellers can share it with their own contacts for a 40% commission.

The done-for-you upsell ('Configuro o teu WhatsApp Business por ti') can be delivered remotely with Claude in about 1-1.5 hours per client including the call, which raises the average order value without new content.
Timing: launching in October 2026 lets the order bump pack target Black Friday (27 November 2026), Natal and Fim do Ano, when small sellers are most motivated to sell more.
honest_risks: No guarantee of being 'number 1' or 'trending' on EscalePay. Rankings depend on volume, affiliates and platform rules that are not public. Treat 'top seller' as a goal, never as a claim on the page or in affiliate material.
Many small sellers are not used to buying digital products; many will ask questions on WhatsApp before paying. Expect conversations before conversions.
Free WhatsApp Business tutorials exist on YouTube. Your edge must be local language, local payment safety, ready-to-copy scripts and the 30-day calendar. If the content is generic, it will not sell.

WhatsApp changes menus and features often, and Android and iPhone differ. Take screenshots on your own phone, say clearly which system they come from, add a note that menus can change, and update the guide when they do.

Trademark risk: 'WhatsApp' is a Meta trademark and it is inside the product name. Do not use the WhatsApp logo, its exact greens or chat-bubble icon, do not imply partnership, and include the disclaimer. If EscalePay or Meta objects, rename quickly (backup names: 'Zap que Vende' or 'Montra no Telemóvel') and keep the domain/page structure ready for it.

EscalePay is young and several points are company claims not independently verified (1-click upsell, exact fee 10% vs 8% + USD 0.50, same-day payout, members area, app notifications). Run a test purchase, read the current terms, withdraw after every sale and never repeat these claims to buyers or affiliates.

KYC approval can take longer than your 7-day build. If it is not approved, do not open sales and do not take informal M-Pesa transfers outside the checkout (buyers would lose the refund protection); collect a waiting list with consent instead.
The 7-day refund policy means some buyers may download and refund. Mitigate with real value delivered fast and a friendly day-3 check-in, never by hiding the guarantee.

The upsell and downsell are services with limited capacity. Selling more than you can deliver in 72 hours will hurt your reputation. Cap them honestly (5 setups per week) and pause the offer when the week is full.

Scope risk: the full bundle is a lot for one person in 7 days. Only list on the sales page what is finished. If something slips, remove it from the page until it exists; never sell a promised item that is not ready.
Without an audience, the first 2 weeks may bring few sales. The launch plan depends on consistent daily publishing and personal, permission-based outreach to real sellers, not on luck.

Many are women running the business alongside a job or family. Urban and peri-urban (Maputo, Matola, Beira, Nampula, Quelimane, Tete, Chimoio, Pemba), using an Android phone and paying almost everything with M-Pesa or e-Mola.

They have no catalogue, no fixed price list, no saved customer list and no plan for what to publish. 'Não tenho tempo' -> about 30 minutes a day for 7 days (around 3-4 hours in total; the catalogue can take longer if you have many products), all on the phone.

blueprint.promise: Em 7 dias, com cerca de 30 minutos por dia, configuras o teu WhatsApp Business como uma loja: perfil completo, catálogo com preços, mensagem de boas-vindas e de ausência, respostas rápidas e etiquetas para não perderes o fio a nenhum cliente. Recebes também scripts prontos para responder e conduzir a conversa até à venda, um plano de Status para os próximos 30 dias e regras claras para receber por M-Pesa e e-Mola sem cair em burlas. Não prometemos um número de vendas: prometemos organização, método e ferramentas prontas a usar a partir de hoje.
blueprint.mechanism_name: Método MONTRA (Montar, Oferta, Novidades, Tratar, Receber, Acompanhar)
blueprint.mechanism_explained: MONTRA ('shop window' in Mozambican and European Portuguese) is a simple 6-step system that turns a messy WhatsApp into an organised selling channel. Each letter is one module and one concrete action the seller completes on their own phone: M - Montar o perfil (logo, name, category, description, hours, delivery zone); O - Oferta no catálogo (every product with photo, price and short description so clients stop asking only 'preço?'); N - Novidades no Status (a 30-day calendar with 3 planned posts per day, up to 5 when there is material, mixing product, real proof, behind-the-scenes, useful tips and offers, plus a routine to ask clients to save the number: with the default privacy setting, Status is seen by contacts who have your number saved and whom you also have saved, so a growing contact list matters); T - Tratar a conversa (greeting and away messages, 25 quick replies, a 5-step chat script and objection answers, labels such as 'Pagamento pendente' and 'Pago'); R - Receber com segurança (always confirm M-Pesa/e-Mola payments in your own SMS, app or balance, never by screenshot; how to handle 'enviei por engano'; never share PIN or WhatsApp verification codes); A - Acompanhar e fazer recompra (customer list with consent, post-sale messages, broadcast lists, which only reach people who saved your number, and reactivation messages). A final module, 'Protege o teu número', teaches what can get numbers restricted (mass messages to strangers, adding people to groups without permission, many reports) and how to turn on two-step verification. The mechanism is credible because every step is observable: the buyer can screenshot the before/after of their own WhatsApp the same day. It does not claim to create demand; it removes friction (no prices, slow replies, forgotten follow-ups, fraud) that can cost sales they already get.

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 1 - Write a module of the guide
claude_prompts.prompt:
You are an expert in small-business sales through WhatsApp in Mozambique and a clear, practical writer. I am creating a paid digital guide called 'WhatsApp que Vende' for small businesses and informal sellers in Mozambique (boutiques, salons, food sellers, cosmetics resellers, small shops) who sell through WhatsApp and pay/receive with M-Pesa and e-Mola. The method is called MONTRA: Montar o perfil, Oferta no catálogo, Novidades no Status, Tratar a conversa, Receber com segurança, Acompanhar e recompra, plus Módulo 0 'Começa Aqui' and Módulo 7 'Protege o teu número'.

Write [MODULE NAME AND NUMBER] in Mozambican Portuguese, with all accents. Use 'tu' (never 'você'), 'telemóvel' (never 'celular'), 'publicar' (not 'postar'), 'equipa' (not 'time'), simple everyday vocabulary and the spelling used in Mozambique (actualizar, objecção, colecção, activar, exactamente). Audience: people with basic schooling, using Android phones, reading on a small screen.

Structure:
1. One-paragraph 'Porque isto importa' with a realistic local example (e.g., a boutique in Matola, a salgados seller in Beira). Do not invent statistics or testimonials.
2. Numbered step-by-step instructions, each step one action on the phone. My screenshots are from [ANDROID/IPHONE]. Where the menu path may differ between Android and iPhone or after updates, say so and give the most common path. Mark where I should insert a screenshot as [CAPTURA: description].
3. 'Exemplo pronto' blocks the reader can copy, adapted to at least 3 business types.
4. 'Erros comuns' (3-5 bullets).
5. 'Tarefa de hoje' checklist (max 5 items, total time about 30 minutes).

Rules: no promises of sales numbers or income; no hype words like 'garantido', 'explodir as vendas', 'ficar rico'; do not claim features that WhatsApp Business does not have; if unsure about a feature, write 'se esta opção aparecer no teu telemóvel'. Keep paragraphs to max 3 lines. Length: 1,200-1,800 words.

Context from my interviews with real sellers: [COLAR NOTAS].

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 2 - Scripts, quick replies and objection answers
claude_prompts.prompt:
Act as a sales coach for small WhatsApp sellers in Mozambique. Write in Mozambican Portuguese with correct accents, using 'tu', warm and respectful, short messages that look natural on WhatsApp (max 3-4 lines each, 0-2 emojis, no pressure tactics). Avoid Brazilian forms (você, celular, legal, a gente).

Create:
A) 25 quick replies for WhatsApp Business, each with a suggested shortcut (e.g., /preco, /entrega, /pagamento, /localizacao, /catalogo, /horario, /encomenda, /esgotado, /sinal, /obrigado). Use [placeholders] for prices, zones and numbers.
B) A 5-step chat script (cumprimentar, perceber a necessidade, recomendar, preço com benefício, fechar com uma pergunta) with a full example conversation for each business type: boutique/roupa, salão/cabelo, comida/encomendas, revenda de cosméticos/perfumes, loja de bairro.
C) Answers to these objections, 2 versions each: 'está caro', 'vou pensar', 'faz desconto?', 'a entrega é grátis?', 'só estou a ver', 'outra loja vende mais barato', 'posso pagar depois?'.
D) 6 follow-up messages for clients who stopped replying (after 1 day, 3 days, 7 days), polite and with an easy exit.
E) Greeting message and away message: 3 versions each.
F) 15 profile descriptions (3 per business type) using the formula 'o que vendes + para quem + onde entregas + como pagar'.

Rules: never pressure with fake scarcity ('só hoje' only if real, mark it [SÓ SE FOR VERDADE]); never promise results; include a line to confirm payment only after it appears in the seller's own M-Pesa/e-Mola. Output as clearly numbered, copy-ready blocks. In total there must be at least 40 scripts across sections B, C and D.

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 3 - 30-day Status calendar, 60 captions and Pack Datas Especiais
claude_prompts.prompt:
You are a content planner for WhatsApp Status for small sellers in Mozambique. Write in Mozambican Portuguese with correct accents, using 'tu' and 'publicar'.

PART 1 - Create a 30-day Status calendar. For each day give: day number, theme, 3 Status posts (manhã / meio-dia / noite), the type of each (Produto, Prova real, Bastidores, Dica útil, Oferta, Pedido para guardar o número), what to photograph or film with a phone (no special equipment), and a ready caption of max 2 lines ending with a soft call to action (e.g., 'Responde EU QUERO', 'Vê o catálogo no meu perfil').

Mix rules: at most 1 in 3 posts is a direct offer; include 'guarda o meu número para veres as novidades' at least once a week (Status is only seen by people who saved the number); include behind-the-scenes and useful tips so the Status is not only selling; include end-of-month/salary-day ideas (fim do mês) and weekend ideas.

PART 2 - Write 60 extra captions in 5 groups of 12 for: boutique, salão, comida, cosméticos/perfumes, loja de bairro.

Rules: 'Prova real' posts must instruct the seller to use only real client messages/photos with permission, with names and numbers hidden; never invent testimonials; no promises; offers must use [placeholders] for price and a real end date. Output a table for the calendar and numbered lists for the captions.

PART 3 (separately) - The order bump 'Pack Datas Especiais': 10 Status ideas, each with a caption and what to photograph, for each of these dates: Black Friday, Natal, Fim do Ano, Dia da Mulher Moçambicana (7 de Abril), Dia das Mães, fim do mês (60 in total). Add a short brief for 5 Canva templates (one per main date) with text and layout.

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 4 - Payment safety module and Checklist Anti-Burla
claude_prompts.prompt:
Write 'Módulo 5 - R de Receber: M-Pesa e e-Mola sem burlas' for a guide for small WhatsApp sellers in Mozambique, in Mozambican Portuguese with correct accents, using 'tu', simple and calm (not alarmist).

Cover: (1) the golden rule: confirm every payment in your own phone (the operator's SMS, the app, or your balance), never by a screenshot sent by the client; (2) common signs of a fake receipt (wrong format, name or amount not matching, pressure to deliver quickly, payment 'still processing') and polite messages such as 'Vou confirmar no meu telemóvel e já te digo'; (3) the 'enviei por engano, devolve por favor' scam: do not send money back yourself; check your real balance; tell the person to contact the operator through official channels; (4) never share PIN, M-Pesa/e-Mola codes or the 6-digit WhatsApp verification code with anyone, including people claiming to be 'suporte' or 'da Vodacom/Movitel'; (5) when to ask for full payment, a deposit (sinal) or payment on delivery; (6) a simple sales record.

Important: do NOT state specific operator procedures, short codes, reversal deadlines or phone numbers; write 'confirma os canais oficiais da tua operadora' instead. Do not invent statistics.

Then produce a one-page printable 'Checklist Anti-Burla' with 8-10 short lines, and 6 copy-ready messages: ask for payment, payment received/confirmed, payment not yet received, reply to 'enviei por engano', reply to someone asking for your code, thank-you after payment.

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 5 - Build the sales site in Lovable (all pages)
claude_prompts.prompt:
Build a mobile-first sales website in Lovable (React + Tailwind) for a digital product called 'WhatsApp que Vende', in Portuguese from Mozambique.

COPY: use EXACTLY the Portuguese copy I paste at the end, with all accents (á, à, â, ã, ç, é, ê, í, ó, ô, õ, ú) and Mozambican spelling (actualização, objecção, colecção). Do not translate, shorten, rewrite or add any claim, number, testimonial or urgency. Text between ** ** is bold. Text in [BRACKETS] is a placeholder: render it highlighted in yellow so I can find and replace it.

DESIGN: off-white background (#FAFAF7), text #1A1A1A, one primary colour deep green #0F7B5F. Do NOT use WhatsApp's greens (#25D366, #128C7E, #075E54), the WhatsApp logo, a chat-bubble/phone icon or any Meta branding. Body text min 17px, headings bold (hero headline 30-34px on mobile, max 3 lines), rounded cards, generous spacing, light images (WebP, lazy-loaded) so the page is fast on mobile data. After the hero, show a sticky bottom bar on mobile with '597 MT' and a 'Comprar' button; add bottom padding so it never covers content or the footer. Buttons at least 48px tall, AA contrast, alt text on all images.

CONFIG: put every link and switch in one file src/config.ts: CHECKOUT_URL, UPSELL_URL, DOWNSELL_URL, WHATSAPP_NUMBER, EMAIL, REFUND_POLICY_URL, AFFILIATE_FORM_URL, OG_IMAGE, SHOW_TESTIMONIALS=false, LAUNCH_PRICE='' and LAUNCH_PRICE_END_DATE='' (only show a launch price when both are filled; never show a countdown). Every 'Comprar' button links to CHECKOUT_URL in the same tab.

FORBIDDEN: countdown timers, 'X pessoas a ver', sales counters, crossed-out 'valor real' prices, stock photos presented as the creator, invented testimonials, M-Pesa/e-Mola/Vodacom/Movitel logos (use text labels).

PAGE / (home), sections in this order, each with an anchor id: hero, problema, historia, solucao, metodo (6 letter cards M-O-N-T-R-A + full-width 'Protege o teu número' card), modulos (accordion, collapsed, with format chips below), bonus (4 cards), como-funciona (3-step timeline), para-quem and para-quem-nao (two columns on desktop, stacked on mobile), oferta (price box), garantia, criador, depoimentos (render only when SHOW_TESTIMONIALS is true), faq (accordion, first item open, with a WhatsApp button 'Tenho outra dúvida' to https://wa.me/WHATSAPP_NUMBER), cta-final (full-width green band), rodape. Follow the design notes of each section in the copy.

EXTRA ROUTES:
- /obrigado: thank-you copy, numbered next steps, a card for the done-for-you service linking to /configuracao, and a small text link to /revisao.
- /configuracao: upsell page copy; YES button to UPSELL_URL; NO link to /revisao.
- /revisao: downsell 'Revisão Express do teu WhatsApp Business - 497 MT' with the pitch I paste; button to DOWNSELL_URL; link 'Não, obrigado' back to /obrigado.
- /afiliados: affiliate page copy; button to AFFILIATE_FORM_URL.
- /privacidade: simple privacy policy (data collected: name, contact, order details; why; never sold; how long it is kept; how to ask for deletion by WhatsApp or email).
- /termos: simple terms (digital product for personal use, files may not be resold or shared publicly, 7-day refund according to EscalePay's refund policy linked to REFUND_POLICY_URL, no guaranteed results, the Meta disclaimer, contact).
Footer with links to /privacidade, /termos and REFUND_POLICY_URL on every page.

SEO: html lang='pt-MZ', title and meta description from the copy, Open Graph image OG_IMAGE, favicon = a white letter 'M' on a #0F7B5F rounded square.

COPY TO USE: [COLAR AQUI A COPY COMPLETA: PÁGINA DE VENDAS, FAQ, OBRIGADO, CONFIGURAÇÃO, REVISÃO EXPRESS, AFILIADOS E AVISOS]

claude_prompts.name: Prompt 6 - Upsell and downsell delivery: forms and packs
claude_prompts.prompt:
I sell two optional services to small sellers in Mozambique who bought my guide 'WhatsApp que Vende': (1) 'Configuro o teu WhatsApp Business por ti' (1.497 MT) and (2) 'Revisão Express do teu WhatsApp Business' (497 MT). I never access the client's account and never ask for codes or PIN. Write everything in Mozambican Portuguese with correct accents, using 'tu'.

Part A: An intake form for Google Forms (service 1), max 15 questions: business name, what they sell, city/bairros of delivery, hours, payment methods accepted (do NOT collect M-Pesa/e-Mola numbers), delivery fees, top 10-15 products with prices, tone (formal/informal), common client questions, Instagram/Facebook/TikTok links, preferred day/time for the 30-45 minute guided call, and a consent checkbox for data use only for this service.
